what_is.heading: What Are Blade Ball Tokens and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: Tokens are Blade Ball's trading currency. You spend them at the Trade Plaza to buy sword skins, emotes and explosions from other players' booths.
They're separate from Coins, which you earn by playing matches. You get Tokens by selling your own items at a booth or by buying them with Robux.

official_prices.heading: Blade Ball Token Prices: Robux vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: Blade Ball sells Tokens for Robux at a flat 1 Robux per Token, so 1,000 Tokens cost 1,000 Robux. There's no direct cash price; what you pay depends on how you buy your Robux.

extras.label: Rate
extras.detail: 1 Token = 1 Robux in the in-game shop

delivery.heading: How Blade Ball Token Delivery Works
steps: After checkout, send your Roblox username in the order chat.
Join Blade Ball and head to the Trade Plaza.
Follow the seller's delivery note. Token sellers usually ask you to list an item at your booth so they can buy it for the agreed Tokens.
Check your Token balance, then confirm the order.
delivery.typical_time: Sellers on DropMarket quote under 20 minutes while they're online.

support_topic.heading: Why Did I Get Fewer Tokens Than My Booth Price?
paragraphs: The Trade Plaza keeps a small cut when an item sells, so the payout can be a little lower than the price you set. Players have reported a 5-Token listing paying out 4.
If a seller is paying you through your booth, agree up front on who covers that cut so the numbers match.

faq_extra.q: How do you get Tokens in Blade Ball for free?
faq_extra.a: Sell your sword skins, emotes or explosions at a Trade Plaza booth. That's the only way to earn Tokens without Robux.

faq_extra.q: Why can't I sell an item I just got?
faq_extra.a: New items from crates, spins, trades or booth buys get a short trade lock. Hover over the item to see how long is left.
